title: Standby board
description: A target board: its true outline, its hard-cover lines and the mark a no-shoot on it carries. In an element extension the file is boards/<id>.json; board targets name it in art.board, and the plan and the 3D view draw it at its real size. Points are mm, origin top left, y down.

id.description: The board id, equal to the file name, such as cma or cma-cut.

discipline.description: Whose target colours it takes (the symbol theme's per-discipline table).

outline.description: The outline, mm, top left origin, y down.

covers.description: Hard cover by variant tag (an element's paint or cover): the part of the board on the side of the line a to b that `keep` is on, by default the far side (larger y).

noShoot.description: The mark a no-shoot on this board carries: lines (the CMA X, the IPSC and USPSA bars) with their stroke on the plan, or two open hands (IDPA).

width.description: The lines' stroke on the plan, mm of board.

linecap.description: How the lines end: round for the CMA X; flat (butt) when not given.

hands.description: One open hand in a `box`-unit square (y down, fingers up), drawn twice mirrored about the board's middle, `share` of the board wide each, centred on `middle`: the palm and the thumb as SVG path data (absolute M, L, Q, Z), four fingers as [x, y, width, height] rounded by `fingerRadius`.

source.description: Where the geometry was taken from.
